description: Kern Behavioral Health and Recovery Services lists a 24-hour crisis hotline for people needing urgent behavioral health support. Call rather than emailing an urgent crisis.
introduction: Kern Behavioral Health and Recovery Services lists a 24-hour crisis hotline for people needing urgent behavioral health support. Call rather than emailing an urgent crisis.

who: People in a behavioral health crisis or concerned about someone else can contact the crisis line. Medical emergencies or immediate physical danger require 911.
sections.get: The crisis contact connects you with support and guidance about the situation. KernBHRS also lists a separate 24-hour substance-use access line.
sections.docs: Explain what is happening, whether anyone is in immediate danger and how the responder can safely contact you. Do not delay an urgent call to collect documents.
sections.apply: Call 800-991-5272 or 988; TTY is 711. For substance-use access, call 866-266-4898. See KernBHRS contacts.
sections.after: Ask the responder to explain the next step and where to seek continuing care. If the situation becomes a medical emergency or immediate danger, call 911.
sections.sources:
• KernBHRS crisis and access contacts
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: KernBHRS lists it as a 24-hour service.
Should I email the webmaster in a crisis?
No. KernBHRS says that email is not monitored 24/7 and directs crisis callers to 988.
Is there a separate substance-use line?
What if someone is in immediate danger?
Call 911 for immediate harm or a medical emergency.
